mac demarco.bio: British Columbia-born, Alberta-raised singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist Mac DeMarco is a Canadian indie-rock artist known for laid-back guitar pop, lo-fi production and an influential DIY aesthetic.

madchild.bio: British Columbia rapper Madchild, born Shane Bunting, is a founding member of Swollen Members and a veteran of Canadian underground hip-hop with a long-running solo career.

magic!.bio: Toronto-formed band MAGIC! blends reggae fusion, pop and rock and became internationally known for the chart-topping single Rude.

marianas trench.bio: Vancouver pop-rock band Marianas Trench is known for elaborate vocal harmonies, theatrical songwriting and a multi-platinum Canadian catalogue led by singer and producer Josh Ramsay.

marie-mai.bio: Québec singer-songwriter Marie-Mai is a major francophone Canadian pop artist whose high-energy catalogue blends pop, rock and electronic music and has earned numerous Félix awards.

matthew good.bio: Burnaby-born singer-songwriter Matthew Good is a veteran Canadian alternative-rock artist who first rose to prominence fronting the Matthew Good Band before building a long solo career.

melanie fiona.bio: Toronto-born singer-songwriter Melanie Fiona is a Canadian R&B and soul vocalist whose career includes Grammy-winning collaborations, acclaimed solo albums and early work with the group X-Quisite.

michael bublé.bio: Burnaby-raised singer Michael Bublé is a Canadian pop, jazz and traditional-pop vocalist whose interpretations of standards and original songs have made him one of the country's most successful international artists.

moist.bio: Vancouver band Moist is a Canadian alternative-rock group fronted by David Usher that became a major national rock act in the 1990s before reuniting in the 2010s.

nav.bio: Toronto-born rapper, singer and producer NAV, born Navraj Singh Goraya and raised in Rexdale, built a global trap career after first gaining attention as a producer and signing with XO.

neon dreams.bio: Halifax alt-pop duo Neon Dreams combines pop, rock, folk, electronic, hip-hop and reggae influences in self-produced Canadian songwriting built around vocalist Frank Kadillac and drummer Adrian Morris.

nikki yanofsky.bio: Montréal singer Nikki Yanofsky is a Canadian jazz-pop vocalist who emerged as a teenage prodigy and later performed the 2010 Vancouver Winter Olympics broadcast anthem I Believe.

patrick watson.bio: Montréal-raised singer-songwriter, pianist and composer Patrick Watson makes lush chamber-pop and experimental indie music and won the Polaris Music Prize for Close to Paradise.

pierre lapointe.bio: Alma-born singer-songwriter Pierre Lapointe is a leading Québec chanson artist whose work combines francophone pop tradition with modern arrangements, theatrical presentation and contemporary songwriting.

planet giza.bio: Montréal trio Planet Giza blends hip-hop with funk and jazz through rapper Tony Stone and producers Rami B and DoomX, earning Polaris Music Prize recognition for its genre-fluid work.

potatohead people.bio: Vancouver production duo Potatohead People, formed by Nick Wisdom and AstroLogical, makes hip-hop and electronic music shaped by boom-bap, jazz, future soul, deep house and funk.

preoccupations.bio: Calgary-formed band Preoccupations is a Canadian post-punk group known for tense, atmospheric music that combines noise, electronics, art rock and indie-rock experimentation.

pup.bio: Toronto punk band PUP combines melodic hooks, hardcore energy and darkly funny songwriting in one of Canada's most internationally recognized contemporary punk catalogues.
